name: The Landings St. Lucia
positioning: All-suite beachfront resort on Rodney Bay in Saint Lucia, officially The Landings Resort and Spa, with a private marina and a full-service spa
best_for: Families wanting multi-room suites with kitchens and an included Kids Club
Couples wanting a beachfront suite with butler service and a full-service spa

facts.text: The Landings sits on the shores of Rodney Bay in Saint Lucia, along one of the island's most celebrated beaches.
The Landings is an all-suite resort set beachfront on white sands.
Each villa has an expansive terrace with views of the marina or the Caribbean Sea.
The suites are multi-room, with kitchens and living areas.
The spa is on the second floor of the resort lobby and has eight treatment rooms and outdoor hydrotherapy terraces.
The spa uses services and products from Natura Bisse.
The spa offers oncology-focused treatments performed by oncology-trained therapists.
The Kids Club, included in the stay, welcomes children aged 4 to 12, seven days a week.
The resort offers babysitting services and baby proofing for all villa suites.
Sports and fitness programs include daily workouts, personal training, racket sports and group yoga classes.
Meals feature fresh catch and organic, sustainable produce sourced from the Caribbean and the hills of Saint Lucia.
Suru serves Asian fusion cuisine and handcrafted cocktails.

highlights.text: A private marina flows through the heart of the resort and is the departure point for dive trips, snorkel tours and sightseeing charters.
Many of the villas have private plunge pools.
The spa's Signature Bamboo Massage Ritual is a locally sourced and produced therapy derived from Saint Lucia's national plant.
Butler service is included with Beachfront and Ocean View Suites and available with Marina View Suites on request.
The spa offers personalized treatments for issues such as menopause, hormonal imbalances, postpartum recovery, aging and menstrual discomfort.

considerations.text: For in-suite grocery provisioning, the resort notes island prices may be two to three times higher than U.S. prices.
Advance spa reservations are highly recommended.
